restaurantName: Restaurant Quack in der Villa Weismüller
bio: You can dine either out on the lovely terrace overlooking the city or inside – in a tastefully decorated dining area blending old-time elegance and more modern details. The ambitious seasonal menu proposes Mediterranean as well as regional dishes. The Chef's Table is an interesting affair: counter seating with a view into the kitchen, and a surprise menu. Good wine list. Be aware that the restaurant is accessed via a narrow private road....
